7:05 Treasurer Report-Mike Bagley

  • Fire Station #3 Update

  • Sugar House Community Council Elections

  • Shawn Sloan

  • Colin Stern see email
  • Rachel Montague

  • DABS Update on new Sugar House Liquor Store
  • Bill Knowles – Construction Update

  • Dr. Brian Moench

8:35 District 7 City Councilwoman-Sarah Young

  • Land Use and Zoning-Judi Short
